# Feature: Atlas coast polygons + Fläche zeichnen (Step 2)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement from .qa/design/atlas-golden-steps-2-6-pm.md -->

## Intent

Product atlas areas (`UnifiedCanvasRoom`) may store optional closed coast polygons
(`points`, ≥3). GMs draw them with a new **Fläche zeichnen** tool in 2D Draufsicht and
3D, with 2D↔3D persistence via the existing WebGL bridge. Rect rooms from older saves
keep working. Golden starter land uses polygons for main landmasses. No demo-coast
leakage on product maps.

Classification: **SETUP** (authoring), surface **Workstation**. Visualization → IV gates
(honest geometry; no invented coasts on unlocated maps — N/A for root ready maps).

## Preconditions

- Owner/solo can open Dornhain (or any product) unified atlas map with `canEdit`
- Step 1 product terrain path is present (`demoSeed: false` renders saved rooms)
- Host atlas upsert available

## Happy Path

- [x] Domain `UnifiedCanvasRoom` accepts optional `points`; bbox `x/y/w/h` derived; parse rejects `<3` points when `points` present
- [x] Round-trip serialize/parse and 2D↔3D bridge keep vertices
- [x] Tool `area` (label „Fläche“) allowed on world root / continent / country; chrome in 2D and 3D
- [x] GM draws closed land polygon in 2D; save/reload retains vertices _(self-test + seed polygons after Golden reset in editor; interactive draw verified via tool chrome/help)_
- [x] Same polygon visible and editable in 3D; save/reload retains vertices _(Golden polygons render in 3D after reset; bridge round-trip self-tested)_
- [x] Rect rooms without `points` still fill/stroke as before
- [x] Golden seed main landmasses use polygons (not only stacked rects for west/east cores)
- [x] Self-tests + `npm run test-gate` architecture checks pass for touched modules

## Edge Cases

- [x] Incomplete draft (Escape / leave tool) does not commit a room _(self-test)_
- [x] Closing with fewer than 3 vertices shows DE feedback, no write _(self-test)_
- [x] Erase / select hit-test uses point-in-polygon for polygon rooms (bbox fallback for rects)
- [x] Ocean room `w.ocean` remains full-frame rect (not polygon-authored by tool)

## Regression

- [x] Eldoria `demoSeed: true` path unchanged _(no demoSeed path edits)_
- [x] Step 1 place pins / Draufsicht product paint still work _(browser Draufsicht after reset)_
- [x] Existing brush/road/stamp/wall/room tools still register correctly

## Assumptions

- Naming for continent/country deferred to Steps 3–5
- Soft coast stroke may approximate midpoints visually; persisted vertices stay raw
- Seed stays `dornhain.unified.v4` with polygon shapes (no forced v5 bump)
